exempt.reason: Absolute source locator checked by the primary for a missing withheld store; custody metadata, not an estimate. Exact presence and location are pinned by ReviewInputTests.test_missing_store_records_and_pass_rows_disclose_checked_path. Canonical missing statuses, withheld counts and flags are compared.
Audit-list copy of unavailable members/cells. Canonical statuses, withheld flags/counts, kept IDs and exits are compared; prose reasons and repeated source metadata are not separate estimates.

Commitment metadata or copy of canonical fit points/NEG-8/tier inputs. Agreement compares canonical model cells, frozen rival lines and tier inputs, and checks stage-2 commitment rebuild/stability; independent hashes/representations differ.
Descriptive alias or unit-removal explanation for compared decode/harvest member counts and the without-assisted line; participating kept IDs and resulting estimates are compared.
Empty collection in a refused fit; canonical refused status, n, k and point availability are compared. There are no interval/point values in this collection.
Empty table at a stage with no applicable rows; canonical pass/model availability and stage exits are compared.
Explanatory prose differs between implementations. Its presence, scope and registered facts (22--25 ms, M13) are compared; numerical alternatives and exact decision words are compared directly.
Explanatory refusal prose; canonical unavailable/refused statuses, row censuses, and absence of estimates are compared. This text is not a numeric estimate or a copy guarantee.
H1 routing/display metadata or copy of measured model intervals. Canonical model energy/interval, frozen hypotheses, numeric/null log ratios, consistency, words and pass availability are compared.
H2 routing/display metadata, unavailable reason or null non-rest slot. Canonical computed/refused fits, n/p/df/k, VIF/correlation and exact decisions are compared.
MoE audit copies H1 misses and model/pass/missing disclosures. Canonical H1 consistency/misses, active-or-resident answer and missing-model availability are compared.
Native parser clock-fit provenance. Fit-derived edges, maximum absolute latency, sample interval and signed offset sensitivity are compared; native parsing/alignment also has direct twin tests.
Null frozen-line slot for an unavailable fit set; H1 missing/null words, missing-model census and H2 refusal are compared in marker_incomplete. A null slot is not a fitted number.
Primary calibration provenance; the twin starts from exported operative bounds. Resulting timing contributions and final cell intervals are compared.

Primary custody/provenance: input paths, stage, module and commitment digests differ between independent programs. Semantic commitment rebuild/stability and release exits are tested separately. The primary restore-module digest is pinned by test_bytes_analysis.Q2CommitmentCLIChainTests.test_changed_module_evaluates_original_commitment_and_labels_rebuild (the exact source digest assertion); the twin implements storage independently.

Primary ingress diagnostic, including records rejected before the meter join. The twin joins exported records through a different ingress; these IDs and exception prose are explicitly exempt, rather than described as copies. Complete kept-ID sets, unit counts, meter-run ID censuses, boundary availability and numerical terms are compared.

Primary removal provenance includes raw-roster members whose missing bundle prevents any export row. The twin cannot name those absent exports at the blinded stage. This is explicitly not a copy: complete kept-ID sets, unit counts, invalid-record gates and numeric estimates are compared; nested primary copies of this provenance have bit-identity checks.
Repeated model/pass identity or measured model-point value; canonical point labels/counts and fit, deviation and leave-one-out results are compared.
Stream locator differs in representation (primary path versus twin basename); numeric per-run meter/battery, poll and edge fields are compared.
Unavailable-row explanatory detail; canonical computed/unavailable/missing statuses, withheld counts/flags, kept IDs and release exits are compared.

Without-assisted descriptive detail or pass-average copy. Canonical per-pass diagnostic energies/bounds, counts and battery terms are compared; provenance and display labels are not separate estimates.

FIX-416-A ruling F3: no precision is printed in registration section 14 for these raw variance, covariance, MSE, derivative, edge-power, idle-power or sensitivity diagnostics. Their differences are counted without an acceptance bar; printed h, B, intervals and coefficients that they feed retain their registered comparisons.

mutation_sampling: Fixed semantic row identities: gross-primary decision rows first for H1/H2/MoE; all campaigns inventoried. Meter projection preserves every emitted schema on both sides.

row_exemptions.reason: Registration §6 labels secondary and flagged-inclusive descriptions as deciding nothing; the independent twin prints H1/H2/MoE answers for gross primary only. These descriptive answer reruns are explicitly exempt. Their measured pass/model cells are compared for every basis and selection, and internal copied disclosures are checked for identity.
